js_array_install_methods.brief: 数组方法安装占位：当前为空实现 / Placeholder for array-method installation: currently a no-op

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.arr: 目标数组对象 / Target array object

js_array_install_methods.note: 两个参数均未被使用，保留以维持调用点稳定 / Both parameters are unused and kept only to keep the call site stable

object_keys.brief: 实现 `Object.keys`：取对象的自有可枚举键 / Implement `Object.keys`: own enumerable keys of an object
object_keys.return: 键名组成的数组；非对象参数为空数组 / An array of key names, or an empty array for a non-object argument

object_values.brief: 实现 `Object.values`：取对象的自有可枚举值 / Implement `Object.values`: own enumerable values of an object
object_values.return: 属性值组成的数组 / An array of property values

object_entries.brief: 实现 `Object.entries`：取 `[键, 值]` 对数组 / Implement `Object.entries`: an array of `[key, value]` pairs
object_entries.return: 由键值对数组组成的数组 / An array of key/value pair arrays

object_assign.brief: 实现 `Object.assign`：把各来源对象属性拷入目标 / Implement `Object.assign`: copy properties from sources into the target
object_assign.return: 目标对象；目标不是对象时原样返回 / The target object, returned unchanged when it is not an object
object_assign.note: 只处理对象来源，非对象来源被跳过 / Only object sources are processed; others are skipped

object_freeze.brief: 实现 `Object.freeze`：把对象标记为冻结 / Implement `Object.freeze`: mark an object as frozen
object_freeze.return: 被冻结的对象 / The frozen object
object_freeze.note: 仅设置内部状态位，实际仍可读写 / Only an internal state flag is set; the object remains readable and writable

object_create.brief: 实现 `Object.create`：以给定原型新建对象 / Implement `Object.create`: create an object with a given prototype
object_create.note: 原型参数非对象时新对象的原型为 `NULL` / The new object's prototype is `NULL` when the argument is not an object

object_define_property.brief: 实现 `Object.defineProperty`：写入数据属性或访问器属性 / Implement `Object.defineProperty`: install a data or accessor property
object_define_property.details: 描述符含 `get`/`set` 时安装访问器，否则取 `value` 写入数据属性。| When the descriptor provides `get`/`set` an accessor is installed; otherwise `value` is written as a data property.
object_define_property.return: 目标对象；目标不是对象时原样返回 / The target object, returned unchanged when it is not an object

object_get_property_descriptor.brief: 实现 `Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor`：读取属性的描述符 / Implement `Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor`: read a property's descriptor
object_get_property_descriptor.return: 含 `value`/`writable` 或 `get`/`set` 及 `enumerable` 的描述符对象；属性不存在时返回 `undefined` / A descriptor object with `value`/`writable` or `get`/`set` plus `enumerable`, or `undefined` when the property is absent

object_has_own.brief: 实现 `Object.hasOwn`：判断是否含自有属性 / Implement `Object.hasOwn`: test whether an object has an own property
object_has_own.return: 包含返回 `true`，否则返回 `false` / `true` when present, otherwise `false`

object_get_prototype_of.brief: 实现 `Object.getPrototypeOf`：读取对象的原型 / Implement `Object.getPrototypeOf`: read an object's prototype
object_get_prototype_of.return: 原型对象；无原型或参数非对象时返回 `null` / The prototype object, or `null` when there is none or the argument is not an object

object_set_prototype_of.brief: 实现 `Object.setPrototypeOf`：设置对象的原型 / Implement `Object.setPrototypeOf`: set an object's prototype
object_set_prototype_of.return: 传入的对象本身 / The object passed in
object_set_prototype_of.note: 原型参数非对象时置为 `NULL` / The prototype becomes `NULL` when the argument is not an object

object_this_toString.brief: 实现 `Object.prototype.toString`：返回 `[object 类名]` 形式 / Implement `Object.prototype.toString`: return the `[object Class]` form
object_this_toString.details: `undefined`/`null` 单独处理，原始值按 `String`/`Number`/`Boolean` 归类，对象取 `class_name`（`Module` 归为 `Object`）。| `undefined`/`null` are handled specially, primitives map to `String`/`Number`/`Boolean`, and objects use `class_name` (`Module` collapses to `Object`).
object_this_toString.return: 形如 `[object Class]` 的字符串 / A string of the form `[object Class]`

object_this_valueOf.brief: 实现 `Object.prototype.valueOf`：返回 `this` 本身 / Implement `Object.prototype.valueOf`: return `this` as-is

object_from_entries.brief: 实现 `Object.fromEntries`：由 `[键, 值]` 列表构造对象 / Implement `Object.fromEntries`: build an object from a list of `[key, value]` pairs
object_from_entries.return: 新建的对象 / The newly built object

object_get_own_property_names.brief: 实现 `Object.getOwnPropertyNames`：列出含不可枚举的自有键 / Implement `Object.getOwnPropertyNames`: list own keys including non-enumerable ones
object_get_own_property_names.return: 自有属性名组成的数组 / An array of own property names
object_get_own_property_names.note: 数组参数会先补上下标键，再列出显式属性 / For an array argument the index keys are listed first, followed by explicit properties

object_seal.brief: 实现 `Object.seal`：把对象标记为封闭 / Implement `Object.seal`: mark an object as sealed
object_seal.return: 被封闭的对象 / The sealed object
object_seal.note: 仅设置内部状态位，属性属性未被真正锁定 / Only an internal state flag is set; attributes are not actually locked

object_is_sealed.brief: 实现 `Object.isSealed`：判断对象是否被封闭 / Implement `Object.isSealed`: test whether an object is sealed
object_is_sealed.return: 已封闭或非对象返回 `true`，否则 `false` / `true` when sealed or not an object, otherwise `false`

object_is_frozen.brief: 实现 `Object.isFrozen`：判断对象是否被冻结 / Implement `Object.isFrozen`: test whether an object is frozen
object_is_frozen.return: 已冻结或非对象返回 `true`，否则 `false` / `true` when frozen or not an object, otherwise `false`

number_this_valueOf.brief: 实现 `Number.prototype.valueOf`：取出 `this` 的数值 / Implement `Number.prototype.valueOf`: extract the numeric value of `this`
number_this_valueOf.details: 原始数字直接返回；包装对象读取内部 `__prim`；其余情况按数值强转。| A primitive number is returned as-is; a wrapper object reads its internal `__prim`; anything else is coerced to a number.
number_this_valueOf.return: 数值结果 / The numeric result

number_this_toString.brief: 实现 `Number.prototype.toString`：按指定进制转字符串 / Implement `Number.prototype.toString`: format a number in a given radix
number_this_toString.details: 十进制或缺省走常规数字转字符串；`2..36` 内的整数在 `±1e15` 范围内手工按位转换，其余回退到十进制。| Decimal or no radix uses the ordinary number formatter; integers within `±1e15` and a radix of `2..36` are converted digit by digit, anything else falls back to decimal.
number_this_toString.return: 格式化后的字符串 / The formatted string

number_toFixed.brief: 实现 `Number.prototype.toFixed`：保留指定小数位 / Implement `Number.prototype.toFixed`: format with a fixed number of fraction digits
number_toFixed.details: 小数位数裁剪到 `0..20`；`NaN` 与无穷回退到常规数字字符串。| The fraction-digit count is clamped to `0..20`; `NaN` and infinities fall back to the ordinary number string.
number_toFixed.return: 定点格式的字符串 / The fixed-point formatted string

number_toPrecision.brief: 实现 `Number.prototype.toPrecision`：按有效数字位格式化 / Implement `Number.prototype.toPrecision`: format with a given number of significant digits
number_toPrecision.return: 格式化后的字符串；未给参数时等同常规数字字符串 / The formatted string, or the ordinary number string when no argument is given
